items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I met all these painters through George Wettling, there was Pollack

ctx.x: Oh, yes, you take all the painters who knew -- I met all these painters through George Wettling, there was Pollack, there was the great Dutch-American painter who got, I understand a couple of years ago over $100,000 for a painting. I don't think any American painter ever received that. That was William De Kooning and I know his cousins who lived in The Hague, a
lovely house in The Hague, where I go to play.
